typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	dStartPreviousMonth as timestamp (toTimestamp('6/1/2021')),
	sRecordStatus as string ('PR'),
	OleDBtoReconControl_outputfilename as string (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		itemId as string,
		effDate as timestamp,
		riskMonth as string,
		rc as string,
		co as string,
		dda as string,
		subAccount as string,
		name1 as string,
		description as string,
		balancePool as string,
		entryDate as timestamp,
		riskDate as timestamp,
		currency as string,
		dr as decimal(18,2),
		cr as decimal(18,2),
		amount as decimal(18,2),
		amtOrig as decimal(18,2),
		create_dt as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OleDBfromKriKpiIntellimatch
OleDBfromKriKpiIntellimatch derive(RiskEOM = $dStartPreviousMonth,
		RecordSts = toString($sRecordStatus),
		RiskAdjEOM = $dStartPreviousMonth,
		dCreateDate = toString($startTime)) ~> DerivedColumn
OleDBfromKriKpiIntellimatch aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> INTMTCHRowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		dda as string,
		amount as integer,
		entryDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		AU_Number as string,
		riskMonth_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		riskDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		description as string,
		Record_Status as string,
		co as string,
		amtOrig as integer,
		subAccount as string,
		dr as integer,
		cr as integer,
		itemId as string,
		effDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		riskMonth as string,
		create_dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		currency as string,
		balancePool as string,
		name1 as string,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 10000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		dda,
		amount,
		entryDate,
		AU_Number = rc,
		riskMonth_Dte = RiskEOM,
		riskDate,
		description,
		Record_Status = RecordSts,
		co,
		amtOrig,
		subAccount,
		dr,
		cr,
		itemId,
		effDate,
		riskMonth,
		create_dt = dCreateDate,
		currency,
		balancePool,
		name1,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte = RiskAdjEOM),
	partitionFileNames:[($OleDBtoReconControl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OleDBtoReconControl
INTMTCHRowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> INTMTCHRowCountCACHESINK
